description: This file implements ping-pong protocol support functions used by various protocols such as FTP, IMAP, POP3, and SMTP within the curl project. It includes functions for sending commands, reading responses, managing timeouts, and maintaining state for protocol communication.

methods.name: timediff_t Curl_pp_state_timeout(struct Curl_easy * data,struct pingpong * pp,bool disconnecting)
methods.description: Calculates and returns the timeout in milliseconds for the ping-pong protocol state machine, considering server response timeout, overall timeout, and whether disconnecting.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_pp_statemach(struct Curl_easy * data,struct pingpong * pp,bool block,bool disconnecting)
methods.description: Performs the state machine processing for ping-pong protocol, checking socket readiness, handling timeouts, and progressing protocol states.

methods.name: void Curl_pp_init(struct pingpong * pp)
methods.description: Initializes the pingpong struct to prepare for a new response, setting timing and buffer states.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_pp_vsendf(struct Curl_easy * data,struct pingpong * pp,const char * fmt,va_list args)
methods.description: Formats and sends a command string over the ping-pong connection, appending CRLF and handling partial sends.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_pp_sendf(struct Curl_easy * data,struct pingpong * pp,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Variadic wrapper around Curl_pp_vsendf for formatted command transmission.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_pp_readresp(struct Curl_easy * data,int sockindex,struct pingpong * pp,int * code,size_t * size)
methods.description: Reads and parses a server response, accumulating data and detecting end-of-response lines.

methods.name: int Curl_pp_getsock(struct Curl_easy * data,struct pingpong * pp,curl_socket_t * socks)
methods.description: Determines socket for reading or writing based on current ping-pong state.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_pp_flushsend(struct Curl_easy * data,struct pingpong * pp)
methods.description: Attempts to send remaining buffered command data over the connection.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_pp_disconnect(struct pingpong * pp)
methods.description: Frees buffers and resets state for cleanup when disconnecting.

methods.name: bool Curl_pp_moredata(struct pingpong * pp)
methods.description: Indicates whether there is more data to read or send in the protocol.

methods.name: CURLcode pingpong_read(struct Curl_easy * data,int sockindex,char * buffer,size_t buflen,ssize_t * nread)
